summary: Frontend-only testing of Fase 2 Ronda 3 on the Agency template site elite-remodeling-roofing. Tested (1) case-study photo gallery add + save + persistence, (2) public case-detail gallery rendering multiple photos, (3) website-translate-en button availability and confirm dialog, (4) public site EN base + ES toggle + image preservation, (5) About page EN default + ES toggle. All 5 requested scenarios PASS functionally. One minor UX/spec-alignment note: the translate-en / translate-es buttons live under the CONTENT tab (inside the 'Generate with AI' card), not the PUBLISH tab as the request text describes — but they are present, discoverable, and functional.

issues: Spec says 'Crear versión en Inglés' button should be in the Publish tab; it is actually rendered inside the Content tab's 'Generate with AI' card next to the ES version button. Consider moving to Publish tab or clarifying spec.

action_items: Optional: move website-translate-en / website-translate-es buttons to the Publish tab (as described in the review request) or update the request text to reflect Content-tab placement.
No code changes required to pass the requested functionality.
critical_code_review_comments: WebsiteEditor.js is 1612 lines — should be split into smaller modules (AgencyPanel, publish/content/design panels) for maintainability.
translate-en/es confirm() uses browser-native confirm dialog — consider replacing with a shadcn AlertDialog for better UX/consistency.
seed_data_creation: Added a second photo (Red-Tomato.png) to case_studies[0] (qdoba) via the editor for test #2. This persists in the demo tenant; can be removed via the editor if needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public API GET /api/public/website/{slug} returns {website: {...}}. Base language is EN (headline: 'Powering Latino Businesses'); content_es contains ES translation (headline: 'Impulsando Negocios Latinos', about_title: 'De orígenes humildes...'). Case qdoba now has 2 photos: QdobaPDX.webp + Red-Tomato.png. Login redirects to '/' not '/dashboard'. Translate-en button lives under the Content tab, not Publish — the previous testing agent already confirmed this. Public pages open connections (chat/pixel), use wait_until='domcontentloaded' + wait_for_selector, never 'networkidle'.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no bugs found. Minor observation: buttons placed under Content tab instead of Publish tab per review text.
